Definition: to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to quench, put out, be put out, be quenched, be extinguished; 1a) (Qal) to be quenched, be extinguished; 1b) (Piel) to quench, extinguish
